The first and second instance case acceptance fees already borne by Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. and Luo in this case shall be refunded by Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd.

Fifth, if the CNIPA issues a review decision upholding the validity of claim 8 of the patent-in-suit in response to the invalidation request, Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd. may separately assert its rights regarding the infringing acts committed by Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. and Luo after the service of this judgment.

Based on the above arrangements, this Court does not support the request of Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. to stay the proceedings.

In summary, the appeal request of Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. is partially sustained and should be partially supported. The facts found by the first instance judgment are generally clear, and the judgment result is not obviously improper. Based on the new facts ascertained in the second instance and the specific circumstances of the patent-in-suit, this Court partially amends the first instance judgment. In accordance with Article 11, paragraph 1, Article 22, paragraph 5, Article 64, paragraph 1, Article 67, Article 71, paragraphs 1, 2, and 3 of the Patent Law of the PRC, Article 7 and Article 14, paragraph 1 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Patent Infringement Dispute Cases, Article 14 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Law in the Trial of Patent Dispute Cases, and Article 177, paragraph 1, item 2 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, the judgment is as follows:

I. Affirm item 3 of the Civil Judgment (2022) Yue 03 Min Chu No. 7208 of the Intermediate People's Court of Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province;

II. Amend item 1 of the Civil Judgment (2022) Yue 03 Min Chu No. 7208 of the Intermediate People's Court of Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province to: Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo shall, after the fulfillment conditions determined in this judgment are satisfied, cease infringing the utility model patent right titled "An Anti-Gravity Water Drop Humidifier" with patent number 20212133****.0, and destroy the infringing products in stock;

III. Amend item 2 of the Civil Judgment (2022) Yue 03 Min Chu No. 7208 of the Intermediate People's Court of Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province to: Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo shall, after the fulfillment conditions determined in this judgment are satisfied, jointly and severally compensate Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd. for economic losses of 7,500 yuan and reasonable expenses for rights protection of 2,500 yuan, totaling 10,000 yuan;

IV. Dismiss the other appeal requests of Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd.

Before the CNIPA issues a review decision upholding the validity of claim 8 of the patent-in-suit in response to the invalidation request, Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo may temporarily refrain from performing items II and III of this judgment. After the CNIPA issues a review decision upholding the validity of claim 8 of the patent-in-suit in response to the invalidation request, Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd. may immediately notify Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo of such review decision. Upon receipt of the notice, Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo shall immediately perform item II of this judgment, and shall perform item III of this judgment within seven days from the date of notice. If the CNIPA issues a review decision declaring claim 8 of the patent-in-suit invalid in response to the invalidation request, and such review decision has become legally effective, this judgment shall no longer be enforced. The first and second instance case acceptance fees already borne by Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo in this case shall be refunded by Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd.

From the date this judgment is served on Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo to the date on which Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo perform item III of this judgment within seven days from the date of notice by Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd., Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo shall pay debt interest calculated at the loan prime rate (LPR) for the same period published by the National Interbank Funding Center. If Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo fail to perform item III of this judgment within seven days from the date of receipt of the above notice from Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd., they shall, in accordance with Article 264 of the Civil Procedure Law of the PRC, pay double the interest on the debt for the period of delayed performance.

The first instance case acceptance fee of 4,300 yuan shall be borne by Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd. in the amount of 4,085 yuan, and by Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo in the amount of 215 yuan; the second instance case acceptance fee of 3,300 yuan shall be borne by Shenzhen [a certain] Technology Co., Ltd. in the amount of 3,080 yuan, and by Shenzhen [a certain] Electronic Technology Development Co., Ltd. and Luo in the amount of 220 yuan.

This judgment is final.
